name: week
title: Editorial week
subtitle: Fictional demo unless you have imported your own records

sections.title: Open work
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,status,due_on,reviews_waiting,tasks_open from v_editorial where status not in ('published','archived') order by due_on nulls last,code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on,code

sections.title: Current revision reviews
sections.sql: select * from v_review_queue order by due_on,code

sections.title: Handover checks
sections.sql: select code,title,can_handover,reviews_waiting,tasks_open,expired_evidence,claims_checked,advertising from v_readiness where status not in ('published','archived') order by code

sections.title: Latest observations
sections.note: Each observation is cumulative to its date. These are recorded figures, not a live connection or a claim of attribution.
sections.sql: select * from v_performance order by code
